entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Watches lending positions for liquidation risk, reading collateral, debt and oracle prices pinned to a single block, then repays debt or adds collateral to restore a target health factor before liquidators arrive.

entries.name: Drift
entries.description: Scans every Venus lending market on BNB Chain and routes deposits to the best supply rate, ignoring dead markets quoting impossible yields and only moving when the gain clears a threshold you set.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.description: Keeps PancakeSwap V3 liquidity positions centred on the market. Withdraws, collects fees and re-mints a fresh range whenever price drifts far enough that the position stops earning.

entries.name: Ladder
entries.description: Runs grid trading strategies on PancakeSwap V3. Buys each level on the way down and sells into the level above, settling every fill through an on-chain delegation that caps what it can spend.
